documented_or_observed_constraint: Very low reported production relative to running capacity
mechanism_in_cycle: Accepted or processable material does not become useful compost
possible_low_resource_intervention: Daily input/output/reject/stock ledger with simple weighing and batch IDs
minimum_measurement: Accepted input; product output; rejects; stock change; operating days
possible_burden_shift: Extra weighing labour or stockpiling without downstream use
persistence_test: Repeat for three months after initial setup

mechanism_in_cycle: Lower material quality causes reject and process difficulty
possible_low_resource_intervention: Targeted source separation on one route or generator group
minimum_measurement: Contamination rate by route and production/output ratio
possible_burden_shift: Rejected material may be moved to another site
persistence_test: Compare treated route with baseline and track reject destination

mechanism_in_cycle: Installed capacity is unavailable or unreliable
possible_low_resource_intervention: Preventive maintenance calendar and spare-parts log for one critical machine
minimum_measurement: Operating days; downtime hours; repair lead time; output
possible_burden_shift: Maintenance records without actual repair or increased output
persistence_test: Recheck after six months and after first breakdown

documented_or_observed_constraint: Staff absence or weak effective labour
mechanism_in_cycle: Nominal staff count overstates actual process labour
possible_low_resource_intervention: Attendance and task log linked to batches
possible_burden_shift: Monitoring may become punitive or exclude informal workers
persistence_test: Check whether data use improves support rather than sanction

documented_or_observed_constraint: Limited maturation space and process time
mechanism_in_cycle: Insufficient space/time reduces product quality and throughput
possible_low_resource_intervention: Simple batch zoning and stock-age labels
minimum_measurement: Residence time; occupied area; product quality; output
possible_burden_shift: Space reallocation may push residuals outside site
persistence_test: Map all stock and residual locations before/after

mechanism_in_cycle: Useful output may accumulate or sales may draw on earlier stock
possible_low_resource_intervention: Opening/closing stock and sales ledger with buyer/use category
minimum_measurement: Production; stock; sales; use; price or destination
possible_burden_shift: Pressure to sell low-quality compost or hide stock
persistence_test: Quality and stock audit after three to six months

mechanism_in_cycle: Transfer interface becomes an uncontained temporary disposal point
possible_low_resource_intervention: Paved/contained unloading zone or timed direct transfer where feasible
minimum_measurement: Spillage; unloading time; overflow incidents; destination
possible_burden_shift: Capital or traffic changes may relocate burden

mechanism_in_cycle: Transformation claim stops before final burden
possible_low_resource_intervention: Residual manifest linking batch/facility to destination
possible_burden_shift: Paper tracking may hide unrecorded dumping
persistence_test: Random destination verification and receiver inspection

documented_or_observed_constraint: Fragmented data and no shared identifiers
mechanism_in_cycle: Facilities and flows cannot be reconciled across agencies
possible_low_resource_intervention: Use stable facility ID and monthly minimum dataset
minimum_measurement: Completeness; duplicate IDs; unmatched facilities; update lag
possible_burden_shift: Data collection becomes a reporting burden without feedback
persistence_test: Track whether records are used for decisions and maintained

documented_or_observed_constraint: Project or equipment handover without persistence proof
mechanism_in_cycle: Initial intervention decays after project close
minimum_measurement: Operating status; uptime; maintenance; output; residuals
possible_burden_shift: Reporting may privilege project success narrative
persistence_test: Independent follow-up with operator and affected receiver
